compiled_state.title: [Script Tests CI]: test-sprint-primary-ticket-model.sh -> 5 stale Phase 1 / Phase 6 references after renumbering
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview

CI Script Tests job on PR #36 fails 5 of 17 assertions in test-sprint-primary-ticket-model.sh because the test uses \`awk '/Phase 1:/,/Phase 2:/'\` and similar legacy patterns. PR #36 renumbered Phase 1 → Phase A and Phase 6 → Phase G.

## Reproducer

\`\`\`
\$ bash tests/scripts/test-sprint-primary-ticket-model.sh
FAIL: test_primary_ticket_in_phase6: Primary Ticket present in Phase 6 heading
FAIL: test_clarity_gate_layer1: ticket-clarity-check referenced in Phase 1
FAIL: test_clarity_gate_layer3: AskUserQuestion escalation in Phase 1
FAIL: test_bug_routing: fix-bug dispatch in Phase 1 for bug tickets
FAIL: test_non_epic_routing: complexity evaluation for non-epic types in Phase 1
PASSED: 12  FAILED: 5
\`\`\`

## Expected vs Observed

**Expected:** Test asserts Primary-Ticket model is in place: Phase A has clarity gate + bug/non-epic routing; Phase G has Primary Ticket Validation language.

**Observed:** Awk patterns extract empty regions because they search for legacy phase names. Underlying SKILL.md content is correct; only the test's extraction patterns are stale.

## Bug Scope

Update test-sprint-primary-ticket-model.sh to use new phase names:
- \`awk '/Phase 1:/,/Phase 2:/'\` → \`awk '/^## Phase A:/,/^## Phase B:/'\`
- \`grep -c "## Phase 6:.*Primary Ticket"\` → \`grep -c "## Phase G:.*Primary Ticket"\` (note: the new Phase G heading is \"Post-Primary Ticket Validation\")
- Update header docstring + assertion error messages to use Phase A / Phase G.

comments.body: Classification: mechanical — test file in tests/scripts/ (not in skills/agents/prompts), deterministic awk pattern updates from Phase 1/Phase 6 to Phase A/Phase G to match Phase A-I renumbering. Routing to Mechanical Fix Path.
